---
title: "MetaboLens QC report"
format:
  html:
    toc: true
    embed-resources: true
    code-fold: true
    code-summary: "Show calculation code"
    code-tools: true
theme:
  light: flatly
  dark: darkly
params:
  payload_path: null
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

payload <- readRDS(
  params$payload_path
)

experiment <- payload$experiment

normalization_summary <-
  payload$normalization_summary

feature_data <-
  payload$feature_data

sample_data <-
  payload$sample_data

assay_order <-
  payload$assay_order

sample_type <- tolower(
  trimws(
    as.character(
      sample_data$sample_type
    )
  )
)

group_label <- trimws(
  as.character(
    sample_data$group_label
  )
)

injection_order <- sample_data$injection_order

batch_id <- as.character(sample_data$batch_id)

feature_role <- tolower(
  trimws(
    as.character(
      feature_data$feature_role
    )
  )
)

biological_sample <-
  !is.na(sample_type) &
  !is.na(group_label) &
  nzchar(group_label) &
  sample_type == "sample"

qc_sample <-
  !is.na(sample_type) &
  sample_type == "qc"

group_levels <- sort(
  unique(
    group_label[
      biological_sample
    ]
  )
)

group_colours <- stats::setNames(
  grDevices::hcl.colors(
    length(group_levels),
    "Dark 3"
  ),
  group_levels
)

sample_order <- which(
  biological_sample
)

qc_order <- which(
  qc_sample
)

sample_order <- sample_order[
  order(
    sample_data$injection_order[
      sample_order
    ]
  )
]

qc_order <- qc_order[
  order(
    sample_data$injection_order[
      qc_order
    ]
  )
]

ordered_groups <- group_label[
  sample_order
]

analyte_feature <-
  !is.na(feature_role) &
  feature_role != "internal_standard"

included_analyte <-
  analyte_feature &
  feature_data$effective_decision_statistics == "include"

curation_metadata <-
  S4Vectors::metadata(experiment)$curation

curation_profile_name <-
  curation_metadata$profile$name

curation_assay_name <-
  curation_metadata$assay_name

curation_assay_label <- if (
  curation_assay_name == "intensity"
) {
  "Raw"
} else {
  toupper(curation_assay_name)
}

curation_assay_display <- sprintf(
  "%s (%s)",
  curation_assay_name,
  curation_assay_label
)

assay_labels <- ifelse(
  assay_order == "intensity",
  "Raw",
  toupper(assay_order)
)

displayed_assays <- paste(
  sprintf(
    "%s (%s)",
    assay_order,
    assay_labels
  ),
  collapse = ", "
)

rla_feature_count <- sum(
  included_analyte
)

rla_plot_title <- function(
  assay_label,
  rla_type
) {
  sprintf(
    "%s — %s (%d analytes)",
    assay_label,
    rla_type,
    rla_feature_count
  )
}

```

## Statistics-included features

```{r}
#| label: included-feature-table

included_features <- feature_data[
  included_analyte,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

display_columns <- intersect(
  c(
    "feature_id",
    "feature_name",
    "mz",
    "rt_min",
    "has_ms2",
    "sample_detection_pct",
    "qc_cv_pct",
    "blank_to_sample_median_ratio",
    "effective_decision_statistics",
    "effective_decision_annotation"
  ),
  names(included_features)
)

DT::datatable(
  included_features[
    ,
    display_columns,
    drop = FALSE
  ],
  rownames = FALSE,
  filter = "top",
  options = list(
    pageLength = 10,
    lengthMenu = c(10, 25, 50, 100),
    scrollX = TRUE
  )
) |>
  DT::formatStyle(
    columns = display_columns,
    fontSize = "12px"
  )
```

## Curation decision overview

These counts cover analyte features only. Internal standards remain in the experiment for normalization traceability but are excluded from this summary, the included-feature table, and the RLA plots.

```{r}
#| label: curation-decision-overview

decision_columns <- c(
  "automatic_decision_statistics",
  "operator_override_statistics",
  "effective_decision_statistics",
  "automatic_decision_annotation",
  "operator_override_annotation",
  "effective_decision_annotation"
)

decision_counts <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(
    decision_columns,
    function(column_name) {
      counts <- table(
        feature_data[[column_name]][
          analyte_feature
        ],
        useNA = "ifany"
      )

      data.frame(
        decision_column = column_name,
        value = names(counts),
        feature_count = as.integer(counts),
        row.names = NULL
      )
    }
  )
)

knitr::kable(
  decision_counts
)
```

## QC CV comparison across assays

```{r}
#| label: qc-cv-comparison

qc_cv_by_assay <- lapply(
  assay_order,
  function(assay_name) {
    values <- feature_data[[
      paste0(
        "qc_cv_pct::",
        assay_name
      )
    ]]

    values[
      is.finite(values)
    ]
  }
)

names(qc_cv_by_assay) <- ifelse(
  assay_order == "intensity",
  "Raw",
  toupper(assay_order)
)

qc_cv_by_assay <- qc_cv_by_assay[
  lengths(qc_cv_by_assay) > 0L
]

if (length(qc_cv_by_assay) > 0L) {
  boxplot(
    qc_cv_by_assay,
    outline = FALSE,
    main = "QC CV by normalization method",
    ylab = "QC CV (%)",
    col = "#D9E6F2"
  )

  abline(
    h = 20,
    col = "#B2182B",
    lty = 2
  )
} else {
  cat(
    "Not applicable: no usable QC CV values."
  )
}
```

## Assay diagnostics {.panel-tabset}

```{r}
#| label: assay-qc-cv
#| results: asis
for (assay_name in assay_order) {
  assay_label <- if (
    assay_name == "intensity"
  ) {
    "Raw"
  } else {
    toupper(assay_name)
  }

  cat("### ", assay_label, "\n\n", sep = "")

  cat("#### QC CV distribution\n\n")

  qc_cv_column <- paste0(
    "qc_cv_pct::",
    assay_name
  )

  observed_qc_cv <- feature_data[[qc_cv_column]]

  observed_qc_cv <- observed_qc_cv[
    is.finite(observed_qc_cv)
  ]

  if (length(observed_qc_cv) > 0L) {
    hist(
      observed_qc_cv,
      breaks = 30,
      main = paste(assay_label, "QC CV"),
      xlab = "QC CV (%)"
    )
  } else {
    cat(
      "Not applicable: no usable QC CV values.\n\n"
    )
  }
}
```

## Injection-order diagnostics
::: {.callout-note}

These plots use the same statistics-included analytes as the RLA diagnostics. Detection completeness is calculated from the raw intensity assay. Median signal is shown for every available assay. QC points are highlighted and connected only within their batch.
:::

```{r}
#| label: injection-order-plot-helper
#| include: false

plot_injection_diagnostic <- function(
  values,
  main,
  ylab,
  ylim = NULL
) {
  usable <-
    is.finite(injection_order) &
    is.finite(values)

  if (!any(usable)) {
    return(
      plotly::plot_ly(
        height = 520
      ) |>
        plotly::layout(
          title = list(text = main),
          xaxis = list(visible = FALSE),
          yaxis = list(visible = FALSE),
          annotations = list(
            list(
              text = "No usable values",
              x = 0.5,
              y = 0.5,
              xref = "paper",
              yref = "paper",
              showarrow = FALSE
            )
          )
        ) |>
        plotly::config(
          displaylogo = FALSE
        )
    )
  }

  display_group <- rep(
    "Other",
    length(values)
  )

  display_group[biological_sample] <-
    group_label[biological_sample]

  display_group[qc_sample] <- "QC"

  plot_data <- data.frame(
    sample_name = as.character(
      sample_data$sample_name
    ),
    sample_type = as.character(
      sample_data$sample_type
    ),
    group_label = group_label,
    batch_id = batch_id,
    injection_order = injection_order,
    value = as.numeric(values),
    display_group = display_group,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  plot_data <- plot_data[
    usable,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  plot_data$hover_text <- paste0(
    "Sample: ", plot_data$sample_name,
    "<br>Type: ", plot_data$sample_type,
    "<br>Group: ", plot_data$group_label,
    "<br>Batch: ", plot_data$batch_id,
    "<br>Injection order: ",
    plot_data$injection_order,
    "<br>Metric: ", main,
    "<br>Value: ",
    format(
      signif(plot_data$value, 4),
      trim = TRUE
    )
  )

  displayed_groups <- group_levels[
    group_levels %in%
      plot_data$display_group
  ]

  display_levels <- c(
    displayed_groups,
    intersect(
      c("QC", "Other"),
      plot_data$display_group
    )
  )

  plot_data$display_group <- factor(
    plot_data$display_group,
    levels = display_levels
  )

  plot_colours <- c(
    group_colours[displayed_groups],
    QC = "#4D4D4D",
    Other = "grey70"
  )[
    display_levels
  ]

  plot <- plotly::plot_ly(
    data = plot_data,
    x = ~injection_order,
    y = ~value,
    color = ~display_group,
    colors = plot_colours,
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "markers",
    marker = list(size = 11),
    text = ~hover_text,
    hoverinfo = "text",
    height = 520
  )

  qc_batches <- unique(
    plot_data$batch_id[
      plot_data$display_group == "QC" &
        !is.na(plot_data$batch_id)
    ]
  )

  for (batch_name in qc_batches) {
    batch_qc <- plot_data[
      plot_data$display_group == "QC" &
        !is.na(plot_data$batch_id) &
        plot_data$batch_id == batch_name,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    batch_qc <- batch_qc[
      order(
        batch_qc$injection_order
      ),
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    plot <- plotly::add_lines(
      plot,
      data = batch_qc,
      x = ~injection_order,
      y = ~value,
      name = paste("QC batch", batch_name),
      line = list(
        color = "#4D4D4D",
        width = 2
      ),
      hoverinfo = "skip",
      showlegend = FALSE,
      inherit = FALSE
    )
  }

  yaxis <- list(title = ylab)

  if (!is.null(ylim)) {
    yaxis$range <- ylim
  }

  plot |>
    plotly::layout(
      title = list(text = main),
      xaxis = list(title = "Injection order"),
      yaxis = yaxis,
      hovermode = "closest",
      legend = list(orientation = "h")
    ) |>
    plotly::config(
      displaylogo = FALSE,
      responsive = TRUE
    )
}
```

### Detection completeness

```{r}
#| label: injection-order-detection
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 5.5
#| out-width: 100%

raw_analyte_values <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(
  experiment,
  "intensity"
)[
  included_analyte,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

if (nrow(raw_analyte_values) == 0L) {
  detection_pct <- rep(
    NA_real_,
    ncol(experiment)
  )
} else {
  detection_pct <- 100 * colMeans(
    is.finite(raw_analyte_values) &
      raw_analyte_values > 0
  )
}

plot_injection_diagnostic(
  detection_pct,
  sprintf(
    "Raw detection completeness (%d analytes)",
    sum(included_analyte)
  ),
  "Detected analytes (%)",
  ylim = c(0, 100)
)

```

### Median signal by assay

```{r}
#| label: injection-order-median-signal
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 5.5
#| out-width: 100%

signal_plots <- lapply(
  seq_along(assay_order),
  function(assay_index) {
  assay_values <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(
    experiment,
    assay_order[assay_index]
  )[
    included_analyte,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  assay_values[
    !is.finite(assay_values) |
      assay_values <= 0
  ] <- NA_real_

  if (nrow(assay_values) == 0L) {
    median_log2_signal <- rep(
      NA_real_,
      ncol(experiment)
    )
  } else {
    median_log2_signal <- apply(
      log2(assay_values),
      2L,
      stats::median,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )

    median_log2_signal[
      !is.finite(median_log2_signal)
    ] <- NA_real_
  }

  plot_injection_diagnostic(
    median_log2_signal,
    paste(
      assay_labels[assay_index],
      "— median signal"
    ),
    "Median log2 intensity"
  )
  }
)

htmltools::tagList(signal_plots)

```
## RLA diagnostics

::: {.callout-note}
## RLA calculation scope

- **Curation source:** profile `r curation_profile_name`, evaluated on `r curation_assay_display`.
- **Shared feature filter:** effective statistics decision is `include` after operator overrides, and feature role is `analyte` (`r rla_feature_count` features). The same finalized feature set is used for every panel.
- **Assay values displayed:** `r displayed_assays`. Only the intensity assay changes between panels; the feature filter does not.
- **RLA references:** across-group RLA uses the per-feature median across all biological samples; QC-only RLA uses the per-feature QC median; within-group RLA uses a separate per-feature median inside each biological group.
:::

<script>
window.addEventListener("load", () => {
  const tabContent = document.querySelector(
    "#within-group-rla-comparison .tab-content"
  );

  if (!tabContent) {
    return;
  }

  const retainCurrentHeight = () => {
    const activePane = tabContent.querySelector(
      ".tab-pane.active"
    );

    if (!activePane) {
      return;
    }

    const retainedHeight =
      Number.parseFloat(tabContent.style.minHeight) || 0;

    tabContent.style.minHeight = `${Math.max(
      retainedHeight,
      activePane.getBoundingClientRect().height
    )}px`;
  };

  retainCurrentHeight();

  tabContent
    .closest(".panel-tabset")
    .addEventListener("show.bs.tab", retainCurrentHeight);
});
</script>

### Across-group RLA comparison

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### Biological samples

```{r}
#| label: across-group-rla-comparison
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 5.5
#| out-width: 100%

old_par <- par(
  no.readonly = TRUE
)

par(
  mfrow = c(1L, 1L),
  mar = c(4.5, 4, 3, 1)
)

for (assay_index in seq_along(assay_order)) {
  assay_name <- assay_order[
    assay_index
  ]

  assay_values <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(
    experiment,
    assay_name
  )[
    included_analyte,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  if (
    length(sample_order) < 2L ||
      nrow(assay_values) == 0L
  ) {
    plot.new()

    title(
      main = rla_plot_title(
        assay_labels[assay_index],
        "across-group RLA"
      )
    )

    text(
      0.5,
      0.5,
      "At least two biological samples are required"
    )
  } else {
    values <- assay_values[
      ,
      sample_order,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    values[
      !is.finite(values) |
        values <= 0
    ] <- NA_real_

    log_values <- log2(values)

    feature_medians <- apply(
      log_values,
      1L,
      stats::median,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )

    usable_features <- is.finite(
      feature_medians
    )

    if (!any(usable_features)) {
      plot.new()

      title(
        main = rla_plot_title(
          assay_labels[assay_index],
          "across-group RLA"
        )
      )

      text(
        0.5,
        0.5,
        "No usable positive intensities"
      )
    } else {
      rla <- sweep(
        log_values[
          usable_features,
          ,
          drop = FALSE
        ],
        1L,
        feature_medians[
          usable_features
        ],
        FUN = "-"
      )

      boxplot(
        as.data.frame(rla),
        names = injection_order[
          sample_order
        ],
        col = group_colours[
          ordered_groups
        ],
        outline = FALSE,
        ylim = c(-2, 2),
        las = 2,
        cex.axis = 0.7,
        main = rla_plot_title(
          assay_labels[assay_index],
          "across-group RLA"
        ),
        xlab = "Injection order",
        ylab = "Relative log2 abundance"
      )

      abline(
        h = 0,
        col = "grey40",
        lty = 2
      )

      legend(
        "topright",
        legend = group_levels,
        fill = group_colours,
        bty = "n",
        cex = 0.7
      )
    }
  }
}

par(old_par)

```

#### QC-only RLA comparison

```{r}
#| label: across-group-qc-rla
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 5.5
#| out-width: 100%

plot_qc_rla <- function(assay_index) {
  assay_name <- assay_order[
    assay_index
  ]

  assay_values <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(
    experiment,
    assay_name
  )[
    included_analyte,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  if (
    length(qc_order) < 3L ||
      nrow(assay_values) == 0L
  ) {
    plot.new()

    title(
      main = rla_plot_title(
        assay_labels[assay_index],
        "QC-only RLA"
      )
    )

    text(
      0.5,
      0.5,
      "At least three QC injections are required"
    )

    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  values_qc <- assay_values[
    ,
    qc_order,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  values_qc[
    !is.finite(values_qc) |
      values_qc <= 0
  ] <- NA_real_

  log_values_qc <- log2(values_qc)

  feature_medians_qc <- apply(
    log_values_qc,
    1L,
    stats::median,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  usable_features_qc <- is.finite(
    feature_medians_qc
  )

  if (!any(usable_features_qc)) {
    plot.new()

    title(
      main = rla_plot_title(
        assay_labels[assay_index],
        "QC-only RLA"
      )
    )

    text(
      0.5,
      0.5,
      "No usable positive intensities"
    )

    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  rla_qc <- sweep(
    log_values_qc[
      usable_features_qc,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ],
    1L,
    feature_medians_qc[
      usable_features_qc
    ],
    FUN = "-"
  )

  boxplot(
    as.data.frame(rla_qc),
    names = injection_order[
      qc_order
    ],
    col = "#4D4D4D",
    outline = FALSE,
    ylim = c(-2, 2),
    las = 2,
    cex.axis = 0.7,
    main = rla_plot_title(
      assay_labels[assay_index],
      "QC-only RLA"
    ),
    xlab = "Injection order",
    ylab = "Relative log2 abundance"
  )

  abline(
    h = 0,
    col = "grey40",
    lty = 2
  )

  invisible(NULL)
}

old_par <- par(
  no.readonly = TRUE
)

par(
  mfrow = c(1L, 1L),
  mar = c(4.5, 4, 3, 1)
)

for (assay_index in seq_along(assay_order)) {
  plot_qc_rla(assay_index)
}

par(old_par)
```

:::

### Within-group RLA comparison

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### Biological samples

```{r}
#| label: within-group-rla-comparison
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 5.5
#| out-width: 100%

eligible_groups <- group_levels[
  vapply(
    group_levels,
    function(group_name) {
      sum(ordered_groups == group_name) >= 2L
    },
    logical(1)
  )
]

old_par <- par(
  no.readonly = TRUE
)

par(
  mfrow = c(1L, 1L),
  mar = c(4.5, 4, 3, 1)
)

for (assay_index in seq_along(assay_order)) {
  assay_name <- assay_order[
    assay_index
  ]

  assay_values <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(
    experiment,
    assay_name
  )[
    included_analyte,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  if (
    length(eligible_groups) == 0L ||
      nrow(assay_values) == 0L
  ) {
    plot.new()

    title(
      main = rla_plot_title(
        assay_labels[assay_index],
        "within-group RLA"
      )
    )

    text(
      0.5,
      0.5,
      "At least one group with two samples is required"
    )

    next
  }

  values <- assay_values[
    ,
    sample_order,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  values[
    !is.finite(values) |
      values <= 0
  ] <- NA_real_

  log_values <- log2(values)

  within_group_rla <- matrix(
    NA_real_,
    nrow = nrow(log_values),
    ncol = ncol(log_values),
    dimnames = dimnames(log_values)
  )

  for (group_name in eligible_groups) {
    group_columns <- which(
      ordered_groups == group_name
    )

    group_values <- log_values[
      ,
      group_columns,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    group_medians <- apply(
      group_values,
      1L,
      stats::median,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )

    usable_features <- is.finite(
      group_medians
    )

    within_group_rla[
      usable_features,
      group_columns
    ] <- sweep(
      group_values[
        usable_features,
        ,
        drop = FALSE
      ],
      1L,
      group_medians[
        usable_features
      ],
      FUN = "-"
    )
  }

  usable_samples <-
    ordered_groups %in% eligible_groups &
    colSums(
      is.finite(within_group_rla)
    ) > 0L

  if (!any(usable_samples)) {
    plot.new()

    title(
      main = rla_plot_title(
        assay_labels[assay_index],
        "within-group RLA"
      )
    )

    text(
      0.5,
      0.5,
      "No usable positive intensities"
    )

    next
  }

  displayed_groups <- ordered_groups[
    usable_samples
  ]

  boxplot(
    as.data.frame(
      within_group_rla[
        ,
        usable_samples,
        drop = FALSE
      ]
    ),
    names = injection_order[
      sample_order[
        usable_samples
      ]
    ],
    col = group_colours[
      displayed_groups
    ],
    outline = FALSE,
    ylim = c(-2, 2),
    las = 2,
    cex.axis = 0.7,
    main = rla_plot_title(
      assay_labels[assay_index],
      "within-group RLA"
    ),
    xlab = "Injection order",
    ylab = "Relative log2 abundance"
  )

  abline(
    h = 0,
    col = "grey40",
    lty = 2
  )

  displayed_group_levels <- group_levels[
    group_levels %in% displayed_groups
  ]

  legend(
    "topright",
    legend = displayed_group_levels,
    fill = group_colours[
      displayed_group_levels
    ],
    bty = "n",
    cex = 0.7
  )
}

par(old_par)

```

#### QC-only RLA comparison

The QC-only calculation is identical to the QC tab above and is repeated here to keep the two RLA sections visually symmetric.

```{r}
#| label: within-group-qc-rla

old_par <- par(
  no.readonly = TRUE
)

par(
  mfrow = c(1L, 1L),
  mar = c(4.5, 4, 3, 1)
)

for (assay_index in seq_along(assay_order)) {
  plot_qc_rla(assay_index)
}

par(old_par)
```
